nodes.label: Captio App - Nuevo Cliente Screen (Spanish UI, Link Generation Flow)
nodes.description: UI screenshot of the Captio web application showing the 'Nuevo Cliente' (New Client) screen in Spanish. The left sidebar navigation includes: Nuevo Cliente (active/highlighted), Clientes, Notas de caso, Archivos, a language switcher (ES/EN), and a logout button. The main content area displays a client intake link generation form: a text field labeled 'Nombre o referencia del cliente' (optional, for internal identification), a blue 'Generar enlace' (Generate link) button with a chain-link icon, and a 'Enlaces pendientes' (Pending links) section showing 1 pending entry labeled '#1 Toledo Realtors' with a 'Copiar enlace' (Copy link) action. The top-right shows a logged-in user avatar labeled 'toledolaw' with an online status indicator. The app tagline reads 'intake · brief · equipo'. A floating help button appears bottom-right. The design is clean, minimal, light-themed with blue accent colors.

pending links list for tracking unanswered intake forms
nodes.purpose: Allows lawyers/legal staff to generate a shareable intake link to send to a client, who then fills out their own case information. Pending links track clients who have not yet responded.

nodes.label: Nuevo Cliente - Client Intake Link Generation Feature
nodes.description: Core feature allowing lawyers to generate and share a unique intake link with a client. The client fills out the intake form independently; once submitted, the case appears under 'Clientes'. An optional name/reference field helps identify the case during the intake process.

nodes.label: Enlaces Pendientes - Pending Intake Links Tracker
nodes.description: UI section that lists all generated intake links that have not yet been responded to by the client. Shows 1 pending link for 'Toledo Realtors' with a 'Copiar enlace' (Copy link) action to re-share the link. Badge shows count (1).
